tagline.text: A San Juan shopping walk linking small tiangge stalls with the newer GH Mall

location.label: Location
location.text: Greenhills commercial complex, Ortigas Avenue, San Juan, Metro Manila

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Indoor shopping year-round; December–February is often more comfortable between buildings

duration.label: Time needed
duration.text: Allow 3–4 hours; a day if comparing purchases or adding a film

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: Per-person half-day allowance for meals, local transport and a reserve; purchases, cinema, parking, flights and lodging excluded

airport.label: Nearest airport
airport.text: Ninoy Aquino International Airport; visit from your Metro Manila accommodation

children.text: Greenhills is a San Juan
commercial complex of connected malls and tiangge stalls
. Compare clothing, pearls and electronics while exploring GH Mall, V-Mall and O Square. Distinguishing the newer GH Mall, opened in 2023, from older shopping areas makes a first visit easier.

Greenhills is a complex rather than one department-store building. Shopping and meals are spread across GH Mall, V-Mall, Shoppesville, Promenade and O Square. “Greenhills” alone may not identify the correct meeting point or entrance, so check your building on arrival. It is distinct from Greenbelt and the malls of Ortigas Center.

Small tiangge stalls coexist with conventional branded stores. Enjoy browsing but leave time to compare the actual products. A low price does not establish equivalent quality, authenticity or warranty. Decide what you need and your spending limit first. Even without a buying list, the indoor stalls, planted walkways and dining areas offer a view of everyday metropolitan commerce.

The newer GH Mall opened in 2023, changing how older guides relate to present shop locations. Treat dated photographs as records, using the current directory and signs for a store’s building and floor. Choose a tiangge section, one product category and a meal instead of trying to cover everything. Set a shopping cutoff if you have a film or dining reservation.

Walk the clothing and accessory lanes before deciding. Record a stall’s name or number and location if you may return. Ask whether negotiation is welcome; fixed-price stores do not necessarily offer discounts.

Pearls are a signature category. Ask about freshwater or saltwater origin, cultured or imitation material, metal composition and repair terms. Not every item has the same grade or Philippine origin. For a costly purchase, seek written descriptions and a receipt rather than deciding in a holiday rush.

Compare the displays and atmosphere of the newer mall with the tiangge. Search the official directory for a brand and confirm both building and floor. A location in the newer mall does not establish that separate retailers share warranty conditions.

V-Mall adds electronics and other specialty browsing. Confirm a device’s model, condition and compatibility and see it operate before payment. For repairs, record the estimate, scope and item condition before handing over equipment containing important data.

blocks.title: Pause for a meal around O Square

children.text: Dining around O Square and Promenade provides a useful break. Confirm that a desired restaurant still trades there and allow for lunchtime waits. Use the stop to organize shopping bags and agree a named building for your next meeting point.

blocks.title: Walk the planted links between buildings

children.text: Take a break in the planted common spaces and links between buildings. Some connections cross active driveways, so the whole complex is not pedestrian-only. Shorten the outdoor circuit in rain and do not expect seasonal decorations from older photographs to remain.
Check the day’s official hours and events and make a short buying list. Save the place and time of any restaurant or cinema booking.
Orient yourself among GH Mall, V-Mall and the tiangge, then browse one section. Note prices, condition and locations before committing to a purchase.
Compare your chosen category and buy only what you need. Avoid rushing an expensive item when there is too little time to check terms, and pause before exceeding your budget.
Eat around O Square or another dining area, then finish with a short connecting walk. Organize receipts and purchases and choose a precise pickup exit. Reduce other mall visits if carrying many bags.
This suggested sequence has no fixed clock times; adapt it to current hours, crowds and store openings.

Santolan–Annapolis on MRT 3 is a useful access point, but it is not inside the complex. Confirm the destination of an operating jeepney or vehicle for the final stretch from the Annapolis side, or check crossings and the open entrance before walking. It is a different station from Santolan on LRT 2; check the line number.

Enter “Greenhills Shopping Center, San Juan” and add your building and entrance. Showing GH Mall, V-Mall or Promenade helps avoid a long cross-complex walk with bags. For pickup, agree the building, level and legal waiting area. Do not run across a road if the vehicle arrives on the opposite side.

items.title: Linking with the airport or other malls

children.text: On a flight day, prioritize airport check-in and road conditions and allow a generous departure buffer. Greenhills is not an airport-terminal mall. Combining it with Ortigas, Makati and BGC can mean long periods in traffic, so add at most one other area. Travel time and vehicle charges vary with origin, weather and congestion.

Indoor browsing is possible throughout the year, while transfers between buildings expose you to heat and rain. Keep outdoor links short at midday. Allow extra time on weekends and around Christmas, and confirm an essential store’s own opening rather than only general mall hours. An earlier weekday visit may suit a quieter trip, but stalls do not necessarily open together.

children.text: Hours differ between the official web directory and mapping services, and weekday adjustments were reported in 2026 (Monday-to-Thursday hours were shortened from April for power conservation, and one outlet listed Mon-Thu 11 AM-9 PM and Fri-Sun 10 AM-10 PM, but no official notice was confirmed). Metro Manila malls were also reported to extend weekday hours to 11 AM-11 PM from 16 Nov to 25 Dec 2026, but whether Greenhills is covered is unconfirmed. Holiday schedules can also change. This guide therefore does not guarantee one opening time, closing time or year-round operation. Check current Greenhills/Ortigas Malls notices before travel and avoid leaving an expensive purchase inspection or repair handover until closing.
The table is a
personal half-day allowance excluding purchases

. Keep a separate buying budget so it does not consume meal and return-transport money. Pearls, electronics and clothing vary too much in quality and terms for one tourist price list. Compare actual products, receipts and warranties rather than assuming a standard price range or discount percentage.

items.note: Personal allowance for a meal and a drink break

items.label: Local transport allowance
items.note: Adjust for origin, travel mode and party size; airport excluded

items.label: Reserve
items.note: Contingency for extra travel or other incidental spending

children.text: The total is ₱1,000–2,000 per person, excluding flights, lodging, purchases, cinema and parking. Browsing and a meal are enough if nothing suits you. Ask each seller about accepted payment methods and display only the cash needed. Keep individual items, payments and receipts clear when shopping as a group.

A half-day visit from your existing Metro Manila hotel is usually sufficient. For a shopping-focused stay, compare San Juan and Ortigas accommodation by actual walking routes and vehicle access. “Greenhills” in a hotel name does not guarantee a location beside the shopping center. Leave large luggage at your hotel and carry a manageable bag.

The official directory distinguishes restaurants by building, including GH Mall, Promenade and O Square. Choose Philippine, Chinese, Japanese, noodle or café options according to your preferences and reconfirm a reserved restaurant’s branch and floor. A familiar name may refer to a different location. Check sharing portions, dietary requirements and the actual menu prices.

A mid-visit meal helps avoid rushed purchases when tired. Sit down to review prices and receipts. If splitting up, agree a meeting point that remains useful without phone reception. Follow shop rules while carrying food or drinks, and keep shopping bags out of restaurant aisles and spare seats.

Record a store’s name or number, building and floor. Similar stalls can be hard to relocate from one photograph. Ask permission to photograph merchandise for comparison and avoid other shoppers’ faces.

Negotiate politely after understanding condition, quantity and payment terms rather than imposing a preset discount. It is fine to thank the seller and move on. Ask about charges before requesting packing or alterations.

Write down descriptions of pearls, metals or electronics and check relevant details on the receipt. Do not assume international warranty or refund conditions match those at home; retain a seller’s address and contact details.

Old shop locations and decorations are not reliable navigation landmarks. Search the current directory, then ask staff about the building and open connecting route to account for redevelopment changes.

A famous label alone does not establish authenticity. IPOPHL has addressed counterfeit trade at Greenhills and announced an on-site IP help desk in 2026. Postpone a purchase if provenance, authenticity or warranty is unclear.
Keep bags and phones close and do not leave a wallet on a counter while browsing. Agree a meeting point and supervise children in crowded lanes.
Check device locks, functions, charging and accessories before paying. For repairs or setup, clarify the work and protect account passwords and payment information; obtain a receipt.

Check the final amount and currency and count change immediately. If a dispute arises, retain transaction records and seek assistance from mall information or security rather than arguing in a crowded passage.
Use marked crossings between buildings and parking entrances, checking that vehicles stop. Carry bags without blocking your view and slow down on wet floors and near escalators.
A separate commercial district for another mall or meal. It is not part of the same complex; consider traffic and your shopping bags before transferring.
Choose it for a different mix of outdoor spaces and dining if finishing Greenhills early. Avoid packing several shopping districts into one day.
A separate area for an evening walk or meal after shopping. Check traffic rather than expecting a reliably short transfer.
